description_en: Queries information about an ApsaraDB MyBase dedicated cluster
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-dedicated-host-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-group-id dhg-7a9xxxxxxxx --image-category WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDedicatedHostGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The image based on which the hosts in the dedicated clusters are created. Valid values:

WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense: a Windows image that contains the licenses of SQL Server Standard Edition
WindowsWithMssqlEntLisence: a Windows image that contains the licenses of SQL Server Enterprise Edition
WindowsWithMssqlWebLisence: a Windows image that contains the licenses of SQL Server Web Edition
AliLinux: a Linux image
parameters.help_zh:
根据主机镜像查询专属集群。取值：
WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense：Windows（含SQL Server标准版License）。
WindowsWithMssqlEntLisence：Windows（含SQL Server企业版License）。
WindowsWithMssqlWebLisence：Windows（含SQL ServerWeb版License）。
AliLinux：Linux
parameters.name: image_category
